        $f0::is_in_triangle_interior(p, first(right_index), second(right_index), third(right_index))

        t < 1

            m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(a, d), m0::f0::vec(a, c)) = ((1 - t) * m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(a, b), m0::f0::vec(a, c)))
    by def $m0::f0::is_triangle(a, b, c)
    have dx R = (b(1) - a(1))
    have dy R = (b(2) - a(2))
    have ex R = (c(1) - a(1))
    have ey R = (c(2) - a(2))
    (d(1) - a(1)) = ((((1 - t) * b(1)) + (t * c(1))) - a(1)) = (((1 - t) * (b(1) - a(1))) + (t * (c(1) - a(1)))) = (((1 - t) * dx) + (t * ex))
    (d(2) - a(2)) = ((((1 - t) * b(2)) + (t * c(2))) - a(2)) = (((1 - t) * (b(2) - a(2))) + (t * (c(2) - a(2)))) = (((1 - t) * dy) + (t * ey))
    release thm m0::f0::collinear_det_expand(a, b, c)
    release thm m0::f0::collinear_det_expand(a, b, d)
    release thm m0::f0::collinear_det_expand(a, d, c)
    have cross R = m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(a, b), m0::f0::vec(a, c))
    cross = (((b(1) - a(1)) * (c(2) - a(2))) - ((b(2) - a(2)) * (c(1) - a(1)))) = ((dx * ey) - (dy * ex))
    cross != 0
    t != 0
    (1 - t) > 0
    (1 - t) != 0
    (t * cross) != 0
    ((1 - t) * cross) != 0
    m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(a, b), m0::f0::vec(a, d)) = (((b(1) - a(1)) * (d(2) - a(2))) - ((b(2) - a(2)) * (d(1) - a(1)))) = ((dx * (((1 - t) * dy) + (t * ey))) - (dy * (((1 - t) * dx) + (t * ex)))) = (t * ((dx * ey) - (dy * ex))) = (t * cross) != 0
    m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(a, d), m0::f0::vec(a, c)) = (((d(1) - a(1)) * (c(2) - a(2))) - ((d(2) - a(2)) * (c(1) - a(1)))) = (((((1 - t) * dx) + (t * ex)) * ey) - ((((1 - t) * dy) + (t * ey)) * ex)) = ((1 - t) * ((dx * ey) - (dy * ex))) = ((1 - t) * cross) != 0
    by def $m0::f0::is_triangle(a, b, d)
    by def $m0::f0::is_triangle(a, d, c)
